title: Cracked Egg Skull Jester
description: A surreal figure with a cracked green eggshell skull featuring large white eyes and a skeletal jaw, wearing a white ruffled Elizabethan collar and tattered grey robes. The creature has insectoid mandibles for hands, holds a green banner with keys and runes, and is surrounded by broken eggshell fragments against a dark smoky background with a glowing halo.
prompt: A horrifying surreal creature with a cracked green eggshell for a skull, one large red pupil eye and empty sockets, exposed teeth, wearing a white ruffled jester collar and torn grey robes.
